Thoth System Architecture: Step-by-Step Production Design

This architecture suite breaks down Thoth into 6 discrete, modular steps inspired by the production-hardening framework from Sanjay Kumar’s Demo to Production breakdown.

Step 1: The Naive Baseline vs. The Production Research Crisis

The contrast between a basic 3-box demo and the failure modes that necessitate a multi-agent distributed system.

Step 2: Tool Abstraction & Resilient Harvesting (The MCP & Dispatcher Pattern)

Abstracting academic endpoints behind circuit breakers, token budgets, and concurrency limiters.

Step 3: Multi-Agent Decomposition (Coordinator + Specialized Desks)

Decoupling research tasks into small, single-responsibility sub-agents supervised by a deterministic Finite State Machine.

Step 4: Dual-Key Verification & Defense (The Security & Gate Layer)

The fail-closed verification gate preventing hallucinations and circular revision loops.

Step 5: Persistent State & Long-Term Memory (The Knowledge Vault)

Separating ephemeral prompt tokens from durable, queryable external storage.

Step 6: Operational Reliability, Observability & Circuit Breakers

The telemetry, cost control, and error isolation mesh keeping the system stable in production.

Final Whole Architecture: The Complete Thoth Production Engine

The full, unified end-to-end architecture showing all data flows, sub-agents, security gates, circuit breakers, memory stores, and telemetry.

Step 7: Irreducible Data Contracts (First Principles AST & State Schemas)

The mathematical and structural primitives that guarantee type safety and clean boundaries across all agent boundaries.

Step 8: Inversion Failure-Mode Matrix (Man muss immer umkehren)

A systematic mapping of every catastrophic failure vector and the specific architectural mechanism that guarantees its prevention.

Failure Vector Catastrophic Manifestation Root Cause in LLM Systems Thoth Architectural Inversion Guarantee Code Anchor
Epistemic Poisoning Hallucinated citations, phantom DOIs, or fabricated statistics. LLM autocomplete prioritizes stylistic coherence over factual grounding. Fail-Closed NLI Gate: Claims are extracted into atomic tuples and verified against scraped text. Unverified sources are stripped deterministically. verifier_node
Circular Replan Deadlock Agent loops infinitely regenerating the exact same rejected claim in new words. Negative critique prompt causes slight rephrasing without finding new evidence. Circular Replan Detector: Checks Jaccard and semantic similarity against rejected_claims; breaks loop if repeated. detect_circular_replan
Cascade Quota Exhaustion 429 Rate-Limit bans from Semantic Scholar or arXiv blocking all future turns. Unbounded concurrent API flooding without backoff or leaky-bucket limits. 3-State Leaky Bucket Dispatcher: Hard semaphore cap (3 concurrent requests) + 30s exponential cooloff on 5 failures. Dispatcher
Longitudinal Context Eviction System forgets earlier turns and hallucinates conflicting answers. Raw conversation accumulation overflows LLM token window. Deterministic Token Budget Engine: Sliding window trims middle turns while pinning initial mandate and anaphoric anchors. fit_context_to_token_budget
Paywall & Scraper Stalls Pipeline hangs indefinitely on a blocked, rate-limited, or JavaScript-heavy URL. Unbounded synchronous HTTP requests without timeouts or connection isolation. Concurrent Worker Isolation: URL scraping runs in an async worker pool with a 6-second hard timeout and HTML stripping. concurrent_scrape_urls
Vault Memory Contamination Inaccurate claims poison future user conversations through persistent retrieval. Writing unverified raw agent outputs directly to the long-term knowledge store. Post-Verification Persistence Gate: Vault files (.md) and SQLite FTS indexes are updated only after the Fail-Closed gate passes. persist_turn_to_vault

Step 9: The Epistemological Rigour Engine (Philosophic Frameworks Subsystem)

Thoth’s multi-perspective epistemic evaluation grid, stress-testing research claims across 10 foundational traditions of scientific philosophy.

Step 10: Latency, Throughput & Concurrency Budget Profile (Theory of Constraints)

The system’s active constraints, temporal budgets, and cybernetic feedback loops.

Systems Engineering Summary:

  1. The Active Constraint (Goldratt’s TOC): The primary rate-limiting step is the Writer Node LLM Generation (~8s). To elevate this constraint without sacrificing accuracy, Scraping and Evaluation phases use strict async fan-outs (asyncio.gather), running parallel workers rather than sequential calls.
  2. Cybernetic Feedback Control: Execution timing, tool payloads, and retry events are monitored live via @observe spans in backend/telemetry.py.
  3. Fail-Closed Stability: If an external dependency or LLM stalls, circuit breakers trip, preventing resource starvation and guaranteeing that partial reports never masquerade as verified research.
